leadingHypothesis: Lumen load exposes timing/input-batching mismatch, causing strongly varying motion blur normalization for similar camera displacements. Keeping both effects and gating RAF at 10 FPS removed the observed scale spikes in the diagnostic capture.

boundary: Read-only source comparison and browser-only instrumentation. No production rendering repair. GPU calls and CPU copies introduce diagnostic overhead; dispatch intervals are not physical presentation times. The visible user preview remains the prior B configuration.
